comment:
* Enum-like class to represent startup features that are supported by the AndroidX WebView API. *

* Features that have framework support should be represented by the appropriate subclass * matching the SDK version where the feature became available, which allows static analysis to * verify that calling the feature is safe through the {@link #isSupportedByFramework()} method. *

* To gain this benefit, variables containing {@link StartupApiFeature} should always be declared as * the specific subtype. *

* To add support for a new API version, add a new subclass representing the desired API level. *

* This class should only be instantiated as constants in {@link WebViewFeatureInternal} and is * meant to act as enum values for that class. *

* Startup API feature checks if a feature is supported in WebView by looking for metadata entries * in the WebView manifest. Calling this method does not lead to WebView being loaded into the * calling process.

variables.name: METADATA_HOLDER_SERVICE_NAME
variables.comment: Do not change value, it is used by external AndroidManifest.xml files

methods.name: public boolean isSupported(@NonNull Context context)
methods.comment: * Return whether this feature is supported.

methods.name: public abstract boolean isSupportedByFramework()
methods.comment:
* Return whether this {@link StartupApiFeature} is supported by the framework of the * current device. * *

Make sure the static type of the object you are calling this method on corresponds to one * of the subtypes of {@link StartupApiFeature} to ensure static analysis of the correct * framework level.

methods.name: public boolean isSupportedByWebView(@NonNull Context context)
methods.comment:
* Return whether this {@link StartupApiFeature} is supported by the current WebView APK. * *

It checks if a feature is supported in WebView by looking for metadata entries * in the WebView manifest. Calling this method does not lead to WebView being loaded into the * calling process.

methods.name: public static Set<StartupApiFeature> values()
methods.comment: * Get all instantiated values of this class as if it was an enum.
